rules.why: A token of the build's own informers that a poll sends back; each build has its own and no screen shows it.
When this build filled its own minute of the answer; the two builds fill theirs moments apart.
OpenCost's window runs up to the moment a build filled its minute of the answer, and so do the costs and efficiencies over it. number-check-cost.spec.ts holds these numbers to OpenCost.
The cluster's metrics at the moment each build asked, kept for its own moments. number-check-monitoring.spec.ts holds them to the Prometheus.
The dev image is built WITH_CLAUDE_CODE and the compared release tag is the one without it, not a difference in the code.
A Secret's describe gives kubectl's last-applied annotation as *** to every caller; v0.7.6 gave it whole to a caller who may reveal.
A node renews its lease every 10 seconds; whether a renewal falls inside a build's first live frame is timing, so one build's frame can hold that lease twice.
